entries.title: Create a pull request
entries.description: Open an interactive PR creation. Add --fill to use the commit message as title/body, --base to set the target branch.

examples.description: Create a PR from the current branch using the latest commit as title and body

entries.title: List pull requests
entries.description: List PRs in the current repo. Add --state open|closed|merged, --author <user>, --label <label>.

entries.title: View a pull request
entries.description: Show details of a PR. Add --web to open it in the browser.

entries.title: Check out a pull request locally
entries.description: Fetch the PR's branch into a local branch and check it out.

entries.title: Merge a pull request
entries.description: Merge the PR locally. Use --squash, --rebase, or --merge to pick the merge strategy; --auto to enable auto-merge.

entries.title: Create an issue
entries.description: Open an interactive issue creation. Add --title and --body to skip the prompt.

examples.code: gh issue create --title "bug: login broken" --body "steps to reproduce..."

entries.title: List issues
entries.description: List issues in the current repo. Add --state open|closed, --assignee <user>, --label <label>.

examples.description: List open issues assigned to me

entries.title: Clone a repository
entries.description: Clone a GitHub repository. Accepts owner/repo, the full URL, or the bare name (if you have one of that name in your config).

entries.title: View a repository
entries.description: Show repository info. Add --web to open in the browser.

entries.title: List workflow runs
entries.description: List GitHub Actions workflow runs for the current repo.

entries.title: Watch a workflow run until it finishes
entries.description: Stream the live logs of a run and exit when it completes. Add --exit-status to fail the gh process if the workflow fails.

examples.description: Watch run 12345 with exit status propagation

entries.title: Show authentication status
entries.description: Print which account is logged in and the protocol used.
